text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often clean up messy code to make it easier to read and understand. Good readability matters because other people, or even your future self, need to work with the code later. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes and shortcuts are used instead of proper solutions. By taking time to refactor regularly, teams keep their projects healthy and easier to maintain. Remember, the goal is to make the code better inside while keeping the same behavior outside.
